widgets.name: Dashboard Summary
widgets.description: The Hospital Operations Dashboard reveals critical insights into current patient census and bed occupancy, highlighting the need for proactive discharge planning due to high occupancy in ICU and surgical wards. Additionally, the report indicates a concerning increase in ER wait times and a slight upward trend in readmission rates for cardiac patients.

widgets.name: Key Findings
widgets.description:
- ICU and surgical wards are near capacity, necessitating proactive discharge planning.
- ER wait times have increased by 12% over the past two weeks, linked to higher admissions volume.
- The 30-day readmission rate for cardiac patients is trending upward, currently at 8.1%.

widgets.name: Key Insights
widgets.description:
- Increased admissions are contributing to longer ER wait times.
- Monitoring of readmission rates is essential, especially for cardiac patients as they show an upward trend.

widgets.name: Recommendations
widgets.description:
Top Recommendations:
- Implement proactive discharge planning for ICU and surgical wards.
- Monitor ER wait times closely and explore strategies to reduce them.
- Focus on cardiac patient readmissions and develop targeted interventions.

Recommended Actions:
- Review staffing levels in the ER to manage increased patient flow.
- Analyze the causes of readmissions for cardiac patients to identify improvement areas.

widgets.name: Data Context
widgets.description: The dataset includes real-time operational metrics from the hospital, with a focus on patient census, bed occupancy, and ER wait times. Limitations include potential delays in data entry and reporting, which may affect real-time accuracy. Methodology involves continuous monitoring of patient flow and operational efficiency metrics.

widgets.name: About: Census by Department
widgets.description:
**Census by Department**

This bar chart illustrates the current inpatient headcount across various clinical departments and wards, providing insights into departmental capacity and resource allocation.

widgets.name: About: Admission Type Distribution
widgets.description:
**Admission Type Distribution**

The pie chart breaks down patient admissions by entry type for the current period, helping to identify trends in patient intake and the effectiveness of different admission pathways.

widgets.name: About: Monthly Admissions & Discharge Trend
widgets.description:
**Monthly Admissions & Discharge Trend**

This line chart displays the volume of patient admissions versus discharges per month over the last year, allowing for analysis of seasonal trends and operational efficiency.
